versions.content: Service name: Mfl_DivLim_f32 Syntax: Mfl_Div_St Mfl_DivLim_f32(float32 x_f32, float32 y_f32, float32 min_f32, float32 max_f32, float32* Result) Service ID[hex]: 0xDC Sync/Async: Synchronous Reentrancy: Reentrant x_f32 dividend y_f32 divisor min_f32 minimum limit, min_f32 shall not be strictly greater than max_f32 Parameters (in): max_f32 maximum limit, max_f32 shall not be strictly lower than min_f32 Parameters (inout): None Parameters (out): Result Pointer to the result Return value: Mfl_Div_St Returns status of division E_SUCCESS: Division operation successful E_DIVBYZERO: Divide by Zero E_INVALID: Invalid operation Description: Divides x_f32 by y_f32 and limits the result within the min_f32 and max_f32 value. Available via: Mfl.h

Service name: Mfl_DivLim_f32 Syntax: Mfl_Div_St Mfl_DivLim_f32(float32 x_f32, float32 y_f32, float32 min_f32, float32 max_f32, float32* Result) Service ID[hex]: 0xDC Sync/Async: Synchronous Reentrancy: Reentrant x_f32 dividend y_f32 divisor min_f32 minimum limit, min_f32 shall not be strictly greater than max_f32 Parameters (in): max_f32 maximum limit, max_f32 shall not be strictly lower than min_f32 Parameters (inout): None Parameters (out): Result Pointer to the result Return value: Mfl_Div_St Returns status of division E_SUCCESS: Division operation successful E_DIVBYZERO: Divide by Zero E_INVALID: Invalid operation Description: Divides x_f32 by y_f32 and limits the result within the min_f32 and max_f32 value. Available via: Mfl.h
